name: Princess Jing

categories.label: Won (princess reached her captain)
categories.labelVi: Thắng (công chúa đến chỗ đội trưởng)
categories.hint: First princess placed exactly in front of her waiting captain wins.

winCondition: The first player to place their princess exactly in front of the captain waiting for her wins the game.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a princess reaches the captain's space.

notes: family: abstract-objective. No points; record which player won. Expert 'Legendary Animals' mode (secret objective cards) not modelled and its win rule is unverified. Verified against a rules summary; the official rulebook PDF (BGG file 193290) could not be downloaded.
